content.overview: Save as otherwise provided in section 378N, the Members who sign the memorandum and the articles may designate therein the Board of Directors (not less than five) to govern until directors are elected. Election of directors shall be conducted within ninety days of registration (or 365 days for a converted inter-State co-operative society with at least five directors continuing under s. 378N). Every director holds office for not less than one year and not more than five years as specified in the articles, and is eligible for re-appointment. Directors are elected or appointed by the Members in the annual general meeting. The Board may co-opt expert or additional directors not exceeding one-fifth of the total number of directors, subject to the voting and tenure limits in the section.
content.glance: Initial Board designation, 90-day (or 365-day) election, 1–5 year tenure, AGM election, and limited co-option of expert/additional directors.
content.study: Section 378P governs the initial Board, the timeline for first election, tenure, re-appointment, election at the AGM, and co-option of expert or additional directors. The 90-day election period is extended to 365 days for certain converted inter-State co-operative societies. Expert directors may not vote in the election of the Chairman unless the articles so provide, and their maximum tenure is limited by the articles.
